end.name: Kiwi Ranch Road car park, Kaitoke
end.quote: the Kiwi Ranch Road car park

via.name: Waiotauru 4WD Road (Odlin's Road)
via.quote: Waiotauru 4WD Road (also known as Odlin’s Road)

evidence: This route begins at Akatarawa Saddle, on the Akatarawa Road between Upper Hutt and Waikanae.
At Maymorn Junction, take the ridge track signposted for Renata Hut.
Continue along the Southern Crossing route over Alpha (1361 m) and descend to Alpha Hut, just below the bush line.
Look carefully for the track turn-off into the Kiwi Ranch Road car park, where the track finishes.

access_points.name: Kiwi Ranch Road car park, Kaitoke
access_points.quote: from Kaitoke, at the Kiwi Ranch Road car park

doubts: No road-end feature is in the packet, so the finish at the Kiwi Ranch Road car park has no ref. Waiotauru 4WD Road may correspond to map track T8 (Waiotauru Track) but I am not sure, so ref null. The Kaitoke end is listed as an access point because the page says the track can be started from either end. The Bull Mound, Omega and Block 16 turn-offs are passed on Marchant Ridge; the tracks themselves are alternatives not walked.
